title: Quick Silky Australian Russet Potato Hash
description: A one-pot dish that combines the natural sweetness of potatoes with the savory flavors of bacon and a touch of flambe. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon and cook until crispy, then set aside.
In the same pan, add the olive oil, onion, and garlic. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the Russet potatoes, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pan. Toss to combine.
Cook the potatoes for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to brown.
Add the flour to the pan and stir to combine.
Dust the pan with a small amount of flour, creating a light crust on the bottom of the pan.
Add the cooked bacon back into the pan and stir to combine.
Flambe the pan with a small amount of brandy, if using, until the flames have died down.
Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and golden brown, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
